n1.speaker: clarke
n1.text: Thanks for coming back, Tom. Before we start — how long have you been working in engineering now?

translations.fa: ممنون که دوباره اومدی تام. قبل از شروع — الان چند وقته تو مهندسی کار می‌کنی؟

branches.suggestion: Tom, tell her about your experience.
He's been in engineering for years.

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: I've been working in engineering for nearly twenty years. Mostly bridges and railways.

translations.fa: نزدیک بیست ساله تو مهندسی کار می‌کنم. بیشتر پل و راه‌آهن.

branches.suggestion: Twenty years! That's a lot of experience.
Tom's been working on the new tram line too.
branches.suggestionFa: تام روی خط تراموای جدید هم کار کرده.

n3.speaker: clarke
n3.text: Impressive. And what have you been doing in your current role?

translations.fa: تحسین‌برانگیزه. و تو نقش فعلیت چی کار می‌کردی؟

branches.suggestion: He's been leading a team of eight people.
branches.suggestionFa: داره یه تیم هشت‌نفره را رهبری می‌کنه.
از ۲۰۱۹ داره پروژه‌ها را مدیریت می‌کنه.

n4.speaker: clarke
n4.text: That's exactly what we're looking for. Why do you want to leave your current company?

translations.fa: دقیقاً همونیه که دنبالشیم. چرا می‌خوای شرکت فعلیت را ترک کنی؟

branches.suggestion: I've been looking for a new challenge for a while.
I'd like to work closer to home and see my family more.
branches.suggestionFa: دوست دارم نزدیک‌تر به خونه کار کنم و خانواده‌ام را بیشتر ببینم.

cultureNote.en: In British interviews it's polite to stay positive about your old employer — avoid complaining.
cultureNote.fa: در مصاحبه‌های بریتانیایی از کارفرمای قبلی بد نگویید.

n5.speaker: clarke
n5.text: Understandable. What would you say is your biggest weakness?

translations.fa: قابل درکه. به نظرت بزرگ‌ترین نقطه‌ضعفت چیه؟

branches.suggestion: I sometimes find it hard to say no to extra work.
branches.suggestionFa: گاهی سخته که به کار اضافه نه بگم.

branches.suggestion: I've been working on my presentation skills.
branches.suggestionFa: دارم روی مهارت‌های ارائه‌ام کار می‌کنم.

n6.speaker: clarke
n6.text: Honest answer — I like that. Have you got any questions for us?

translations.fa: جواب صادقانه — خوشم میاد. سؤالی از ما داری؟

branches.suggestion: What does a typical day look like?
When will you make a decision?

n7.speaker: clarke
n7.text: We'll let you know by Friday. Off the record, Tom — it's looking very good.

translations.fa: تا جمعه خبرت می‌کنیم. بین خودمون باشه تام — اوضاع خیلی خوب به نظر میاد.
